organization: The QoG Institute, University of Gothenburg

notes: check current submission and seminar routes on the institute page; use institutional channels only

organization: Centre for the Study of Corruption, University of Sussex
field: corruption and governance, state capture, integrity systems

notes: use the institutional contact route; the centre page lists individual staff emails but none are used here

organization: Governance and Integrity Anti-Corruption Evidence (GI ACE)
field: anti-corruption evidence, state capture, integrity systems

notes: the page explicitly welcomes enquiries from policymakers, researchers, practitioners and members of the public

public_contact_or_submission: public agenda suggestion route and institutional contact point on the conference site

organization: Transparency International Knowledge Hub, Anti-Corruption Helpdesk
